definitions.full: H7976. shilluchah or sheluchah [ שְׁלוּחָה ] noun feminine shoot, branch (compare I. שֶׁלַח 2 ); — plural suffix שְׁלוּחֹתֶיהָ Isa 16:8 , of vine of Sibmah (east of Jordan).
